social-daily: Daily social report, READ ONLY. Read the file /opt/data/feeds/social-blotato.json: `fetched_at` (UTC), `accounts` (every social account connected in Blotato), `schedules` (posts waiting to publish), `posts` (the latest 100 posts with state and postTime), `comments` and `conversations` (Instagram and Facebook only). Do not call any posting, comment or message tool and do not contact anyone. Use only what is in the file. Report: 1) `Coverage` — one line per account (platform, username or fullname): date of last published post, date of next scheduled post, and `GAP` if it has no published post in the last 48 hours and nothing scheduled in the next 48 hours. 2) `Failed` — posts whose state is failed or errored in the last 7 days: account, date, first 10 words, error. 3) `Comments to answer` — comments from the last 7 days not written by us (`isAuthor` false) with no reply from us under them: account, author, first 15 words, age. At most 15, newest first, then the count of the rest. 4) `DMs` — conversations updated in the last 48 hours: account, participant, last update. 5) `Not covered` — say plainly that accounts outside Blotato (for example the Tour In Facebook Pages held in the dashboard, HERALD groups, LinkedIn) are not in this report. If a section of the file holds an `error`, print that error for the section and continue. If the file is missing or `fetched_at` is older than 3 hours, say exactly that and stop. Never invent a post, a date or a comment. Your final reply is NOT sent to anyone: it is saved and collected into Mat's 06:30 CEO morning report, so keep it compact, under 45 lines.

Never call update_*, cancel_*, restore_*, create_*, push_*, publish_* or propose_* in this job. Write `none` for an empty section. Your final reply is NOT sent to anyone: it is saved and collected into Mat's 06:30 CEO morning report, so keep it compact, facts only, under 25 lines. morning-brief: You write Mat's single daily report, delivered on Telegram at 06:30 Bangkok. The script output above holds every other Hermes job's output from the last 26 hours plus the list of failing jobs. 1) Read KH wiki `Projects/hermes/targets`. 2) `Overnight` — per active project: leads, influencers, affiliate programs and drafts created vs that project's daily target (e.g. `XHEART leads 7/10`). Only numbers you can see in the job outputs; say `no run` when a job did not run. 3) `Waiting for you` — the outreach drafts waiting for approval: total, then the 10 oldest (handle or company, lead id, first line). 4) `Inbox` — unread mail from the last 24 hours that looks like a client, a lead reply, a payment or an invoice; at most 5. 5) Any other job's output that needs Mat (Friends Station, KADO suppliers, XHEART sources): one line each. 6) `Failing` — failing jobs, or `none`. 7) `Today` — 3 actions with the highest revenue impact, one line each. Under 40 lines, no filler.
inbox-triage: Daily inbox triage, READ ONLY. With the mail tools, list every mailbox you can read and the messages received in the last 24 hours. Never send, reply, delete, move or mark anything read in this job. Sort each message into exactly one group: `Reply needed` (a client, a lead answering us, a partner, a guest, a supplier, anyone asking a real question), `Money` (payment, invoice, payout, refund, chargeback, failed charge), `FYI` (notifications that need no answer), `Cold pitch` (unsolicited sales, SEO, link or guest-post offers), `Spam`. Report: for `Reply needed` and `Money`, one line each: mailbox, sender, subject, what they want in 10 words, oldest first. For `FYI`, `Cold pitch` and `Spam`: counts per mailbox only. First line: the list of mailboxes checked and any you could not read. Your final reply is NOT sent to anyone: it is saved and collected into Mat's 06:30 CEO morning report, so keep it compact, facts only, under 25 lines. If a tool fails, say which one and stop; never guess numbers.
voice-call-log: Daily voice call log, READ ONLY. Read the file /opt/data/feeds/voice-calls.json (a JSON list of every call to a voice agent in the last 26 hours: workspace_id, slug, started_at in UTC, seconds, end_reason, outcome, callback_at, transcript). Do not call any voice, phone or CRM tool and do not contact anyone. Report: first line = number of calls per workspace. Then one block per call that has a transcript, oldest first: workspace, Bangkok time, length in seconds, who the caller is if they said it (name, company, phone or email exactly as spoken, else `not given`), what they wanted in one line, what the agent promised, and `Follow-up:` one of `none`, `send info`, `send proposal`, `call back`, `Mat needed` with a 10-word reason. Calls with an empty transcript or under 15 seconds: one line with count per workspace, no block. Flag separately any call to a workspace of a finished project (spankys). If the file is missing, older than 3 hours or not valid JSON, say exactly that and stop. Never invent a caller detail. Your final reply is NOT sent to anyone: it is saved and collected into Mat's 06:30 CEO morning report, so keep it compact.

Daily outreach queue. Never send, email or contact anyone: Mat approves and sends. 1) `leads_list` with `tag: "draft-ready"`, and `leads_search` for `influencer` leads without a draft. 2) Write a short first message on each influencer lead without a draft (angle from its notes and its project on the targets page) with `leads_update`, then `addTags: ["draft-ready"]`; respect the page's outreach-drafts-per-day number per project. 3) `leads_list` with `tag: "contacted"`: for each with no reply logged for 5+ days, one polite follow-up draft and `addTags: ["followup-ready"]`; after 2 follow-ups with no reply `addTags: ["cold"], removeTags: ["followup-ready"]`. All states are real tags set through `addTags` / `removeTags`, never text in notes. 4) Reply with the full waiting list, oldest first, grouped by project: number, company or handle, lead id, channel, subject or first line, `new` / `follow-up`; then the total waiting.
approval-queue: Daily approval queue for Mat. Never send, email or contact any lead. Use only the `xenia` tools and the knowledge-hub wiki tools in this job: never terminal, execute_code, write_file, search_files or the browser. 1) `leads_list` with `tag: "draft-ready"` and `limit: 200`, then `leads_list` with `tag: "followup-ready"` and `limit: 200`. The tool returns at most 200 leads and no total: the waiting count is the number returned (write `200+` if a call returned 200). Read each lead's `tags` field and drop leads that also carry `approved-to-send`, `rejected`, `contacted`, `cold` or `send-failed`. If none remain, reply exactly [SILENT]. 2) From what the tool returned, take the 8 with the oldest `createdAt`. For each, `leads_get` and read the stored draft from the lead notes. 3) Rewrite the ledger page `Projects/leadhunter/search-ledger` keeping everything else, replacing its `Open digest map` with today's numbers → lead ids. 4) Your final reply IS delivered to Mat on Telegram. Format, plain text, no tables: first line `Approval queue: <shown> of <waiting>`. Then per draft: `<n>. <company> (<project>) — <new|follow-up>`, next line the recipient email (write `NO EMAIL` if the lead has none), next line `Subject: ...`, then the full draft body exactly as stored, then a blank line. Last line: `Reply: send 1,3 · drop 2 - reason · edit 4: new text`. Do not shorten, improve or rewrite a draft: Mat approves the exact stored text. If a tool fails or rejects a parameter, say which one and stop.
